responsibility: This header declares the builtin-support interface used by libgccjit internals. It defines the generated enums for JIT builtin type signatures and builtin attribute encodings, and declares builtins_manager, which owns lookup, lazy construction, caching, playback-time attribute generation, and optimization-related builtin provisioning for recording::context instances. It is the public internal contract for builtin handling across jit-recording and jit-playback.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-builtins.cc, which contains the builtin lookup and construction logic, this same-stem header defines the generated builtin-type and builtin-attribute enums and declares the builtins_manager interface consumed by other JIT internals.
